pack_name: Broadway Blueshirts: Rangers Through the Years
narrative: Collect the full New York Rangers playing history: 1,162 players from 1926 onward, including playoff-only appearances. Original affectionate caricatures meet verified Rangers-only statistics. Fan-favorite rarity is editorial; popular icons are the hardest individual pulls. Three matching copies evolve from Rinkside to Spotlight to Garden Glow.
rarity_policy: Editorial fan-favorite rarity informed by official honors and team recognition; not an objective popularity ranking or fan-vote result.
